blocks.text: This article provides troubleshooting information and guidelines for Remediation.
When troubleshooting Remediation, consider the following:

blocks.item: If the devices you want to select are grayed out during device selection, it might be due to:
Unable to Run Remote Scripts on Specific Devices
If the Remediation job did not complete because the remote script did not run on the selected device, these can be the following reasons:
Selected device is unavailable and cannot run the remote script from the Remediation job. This can be due to:
The device is not powered on.
The device is not connected to Wi-Fi.
Selected device is running Zscaler Client Connector version that is older than 4.8.0.151 or ZDX Module is older than 4.6.0. To learn more, see Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.
An admin aborted the Remediation job mid-way and the remote script only ran on selected devices before the abortion.
Internet & SaaS (ZIA) policy blocks remote scripts from running on device. If this occurs, check to see if:
ps1 files are blocked. To learn more, see About File Type Control Policy.
The URL policy is blocking unknown URLs. To learn more, see About URL Categories.
If any of these are the issue, configure them accordingly to allow ps1 files to run on devices and allow your specified remediation URL into a URL category.
You cannot run a remote script that is signed with an invalid certificate due to certificate expiration or invalid credentials.
You must sign the script again with an appropriate certificate expiration and valid credentials.
To learn more, see Preparing Custom Script Signing.
